plugins.name: dispatch
plugins.description: Parallel model dispatch in agent-workflow mode: main agent commands, subagents execute and report back. Four tiers: Flash pool, FlashX speed batches, heavy workers, and dynamic workflows for any cross-provider model with reasoning-level control.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Agent 工作流模式：主 Agent 指挥、子 Agent 执行回传。四档通道：flash 群集、flashx 快速批、heavy 分身、动态工作流（跨路由任意模型+等级控制）；派发前先确认模型/等级/并发数
